root_cause: During WAIT_CONVERGENCE_PEER each client directly reads the other client's result file before coordinator PREPARE. This creates a distributed peer-to-peer barrier even though the parent already owns convergence coordination.
The client code documents release consumption as the exact convergence acceptance point, but a consumed release can later call _revoke_convergence_prepare() and clear convergence_release_consumed.

The parent reads a.json then b.json sequentially. If a consumed release is revocable, the parent can combine a stale A=CONVERGENCE_RELEASED snapshot with a later B=CONVERGENCE_RELEASED snapshot and falsely conclude BOTH_RELEASES_CONSUMED while neither current client state remains released.
R5's simultaneous 150s WAIT_CONVERGENCE_PEER timeouts plus green parent-side coordination assertions are consistent with this temporal-skew/revocation failure.
authorized_changes: Remove direct peer-result gating from the convergence phase. Clients publish their own READY_TO_CONVERGE checksums; the parent is the sole pair matcher.
Allow the parent to create a convergence generation when both current client reports are READY_TO_CONVERGE or CONVERGENCE_LOCKED with identical non-empty player and Item Graph checksums.
Clients acknowledge only a parent-authored convergence_prepare matching their current authoritative checksums, then wait for parent release.

Make convergence_release_consumed monotonic for its generation. After consumption, control-generation regression or authoritative checksum drift is a named FAIL-CLOSED condition, not a silent revoke/retry.
Parent COMPLETE remains gated on both durable CONVERGENCE_RELEASED reports for the exact generation.
Add pure barrier regression coverage for post-release monotonic integrity and static contract guards proving convergence no longer reads peer result files.
Wire the pure convergence release guard regression into RUN_NETWORK_CONTRACT_TESTS.ps1 so monotonicity is exercised by the focused network belt.
non_goals: Do not weaken checksum equality, generation identity, release guards, graceful leave or final server assertions.
Do not change product network/LEAVE/SM1 runtime semantics.
Do not erase the dormant R3 silent-A2 failure; R5 shows the active reproducible defect is the convergence barrier deadlock.
acceptance_r6: M5 contracts PASS including centralized-convergence guards.
m5_convergence_release_guard_regression PASS with explicit post-release monotonic/fail-closed cases.
Windows exact-Godot stability gate reaches 10/10 with no hidden reruns.
No client may transition from CONVERGENCE_RELEASED back to READY_TO_CONVERGE for the same generation.
If post-release state/control changes, failure must be explicit and immediate, not WAIT_CONVERGENCE_PEER timeout.
Only after Windows 10/10 may one canonical full world regression first attempt be considered.
escalation_rule: If R6 still fails, preserve the first failure and exact a2/b/control/lifecycle reports. Any subsequent repair must follow the named failure; do not reintroduce peer-to-peer convergence waits or revocable consumed-release acknowledgements.
